description: This Java class 'BaseMap' provides functionality to load and parse data from a CSV file into XYData objects, associating engine RPM values with other parameters such as 'maf' or 'af'. It registers an engine state listener that processes key-value pairs from each line, constructing 3D points for plotting or analysis.

classes.name: BaseMap
classes.description: Main class containing static method to load data from CSV and process it

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data from a CSV file, parses key-value pairs, and constructs XYData points with RPM and other parameters
